description: Park the session while lobstah work is in flight; wake it the moment something needs attention. The Stop hook is inert unless the directory opts in with a .lobstah-man file (or LOBSTAH_MAN=1) or the session is soaking (lobstah soak). SessionStart announces the session id; SessionEnd stows a soaking session cleanly.

hooks.statusMessage: lobstah park — waiting for the fleet
